name: Preferences
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Open the options window, change the palette and the language
description: Settings ▸ Options… (F5) opens the player's options window. Settings ▸ Appearance picks the palette (Vestra Dark, Vestra Light); the options window also has an Appearance page with previews. Settings ▸ Language picks the interface language, used from the next start.
